findings.claim: The observed landmark_00_soft_mass curve over the full support [0.0,0.49] (50 score nodes, 14 independent batches) rises from a negative first-node value (first_z=-0.366) to a mid-window peak near node 16, then declines to a negative last-node value (last_z=-0.275); the whole-window trend is positive (whole_window_z=0.639) but the profile has 4 sign changes and 1 strong sign conflict, so the aggregate trend is not monotone.

The landmark_00_soft_mass local rate is positive at the first node (first_rate_z=9.27) and negative at the last node (last_rate_z=-10.00), i.e. the local rate reverses sign within the observed window.

landmark_00_local_cxx has a negative whole-window trend (whole_window_z=-0.579, 14 batches) with 6 sign changes and 2 strong sign conflicts; first_rate_z=-7.87 and last_rate_z=+15.87, a rate sign reversal.
landmark_00_local_cyy has a negative whole-window trend (whole_window_z=-0.575, 14 batches) with 4 sign changes and 1 strong sign conflict; first_rate_z=-36.49 and last_rate_z=+17.14.
landmark_00_local_czz has a negative whole-window trend (whole_window_z=-0.312, 14 batches) with 7 sign changes and 6 strong sign conflicts; first_rate_z=+15.19 and last_rate_z=-6.34.
landmark_00_local_dy has a negative whole-window trend (whole_window_z=-0.301, 14 batches) with 6 sign changes and 4 strong sign conflicts; first_rate_z=-72.37 and last_rate_z=+5.52.
landmark_00_local_cyz has a negative whole-window trend (whole_window_z=-0.254, 14 batches) with 7 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts; first_rate_z=-16.40 and last_rate_z=+8.92.
landmark_00_local_dx has a negative whole-window trend (whole_window_z=-0.184, 14 batches) with 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts; first_rate_z=-17.49 and last_rate_z=+8.11.
landmark_00_local_cxz has a positive whole-window trend (whole_window_z=0.137, 14 batches) with 7 sign changes and 2 strong sign conflicts; first_rate_z=+8.76 and last_rate_z=+9.97.
landmark_00_local_cxy has a positive whole-window trend (whole_window_z=0.099, 14 batches) with 9 sign changes and 14 strong sign conflicts; first_rate_z=+64.83 and last_rate_z=-19.67.
landmark_00_local_dz has a near-zero whole-window trend (whole_window_z=-0.024, 14 batches) with 10 sign changes and 7 strong sign conflicts; first_rate_z=+14.14 and last_rate_z=-2.38.

All ten landmark_00 continuous_trends rows report polynomial_accepted=false with relative_node_RMSE between 0.286 and 0.867 and extrapolation_allowed=false, so no smooth polynomial description of these coordinate features is supported over the observed window.

hypotheses.direction: weaker early / stronger late (or the reverse); direction not resolved by the aggregate trend alone
hypotheses.falsifier: No measurable difference in the landmark_00_soft_mass trajectory between the candidate schedule and flat dose, or a difference that is fully explained by a change in total delivered displacement rather than timing.
hypotheses.scope: whole observed window [0.0,0.49], all 50 score nodes
hypotheses.statement: If the landmark_00_soft_mass coordinate contrast is genuinely time-dependent rather than a stationary target, then a dose schedule that is weaker early and stronger late (or the reverse) should produce a measurable difference in the realized landmark_00_soft_mass trajectory relative to a flat dose, because the observed local rate is positive at the first node and negative at the last node.

limitations: Only landmark_00_soft_mass was read as an actual curve; the other landmark_00 features and landmark_01 through landmark_19 were not read as curves and their temporal behavior is unobserved here.

No stage profiles or temporal profiles are available (stage_profiles_available=false, temporal_profiles_available=false); all temporal statements rest on the observed landmark_00_soft_mass curve, continuous_trends rows and the clock metadata.
All landmark_00 continuous_trends rows have polynomial_accepted=false and extrapolation_allowed=false, so no smooth polynomial or extrapolated description of these features is supported.

Every landmark_00 feature shows multiple sign changes (4-10) and at least one strong sign conflict, so the whole-window trend sign is not a stable per-node direction; the first/last rate signs are endpoints of a noisy profile, not a monotone schedule.

The clock metadata reports label_semantics 'Recorded affinities removed; equal score prior', so these coordinate contrasts are selection-association evidence only and do not establish descendant survival or measured final affinity benefit.
No current study quality outcomes are available to the role, so no claim is made that any candidate schedule improves final predicted affinity, validity or strain.
The registered dose recipes (W1_early_soft, W2_middle_peak, W3_early_strong_control) are proposed interventions, not parameters learned from these temporal slopes; no optimal dose is inferred.
